name: Lumina Sprout
description: A beginner's plant that emits a faint, comforting glow. It thrives on small daily victories and consistent waterings. Legend says it was the first plant to ever grow in the bio-labs of Verde.

name: Shadow Fern
description: Grows in the darker corners of the laboratory. It absorbs stress and anxiety, converting them into dark, rich oxygen. Requires patience and calm handling.

name: Neon Ivy
description: An aggressive climber with veins that pulse with electric green light. It symbolizes rapid growth and ambition. Keep it trimmed, or it might take over your entire greenhouse.

name: Crystal Succulent
description: Its leaves are transparent and hard as diamonds. It reflects the purity of your intent. Only grows when you are perfectly honest with your daily journal entries.

name: Ember Orchid
description: Warm to the touch, this flower blooms in bursts of heat. It represents passion and drive. Don't let its fire go out, or it turns into cold ash.

name: Void Moss
description: A strange, velvety moss that seems to absorb light. It thrives on silence and meditation. Perfect for the corner of your digital garden where you seek peace.

name: Azure Lily
description: Floating on invisible water, this lily sings a quiet melody when you are productive. A favorite among the ancient hydroponic gardeners.

name: Iron Root
description: As unyielding as steel, this plant represents discipline. It grows slowly but cannot be destroyed by normal means. Build your foundation upon it.
unlockCondition: Log in 7 days in a row

name: Golden Bonsai
description: A miniature tree with leaves of pure gold foil. It brings prosperity and focus to those who trim it daily. A symbol of wealth in spirit and mind.

name: Whispering Willow
description: Its long tendrils sway without wind. If you listen closely, it whispers secrets about productivity and time management. A gossip, but a useful one.

name: Toxic Briar
description: A manifestation of procrastination. It has sharp thorns that prick your motivation. Shrink this weed by completing tasks on time.

name: Sloth Vine
description: A heavy, sluggish vine that drags down other plants. It grows when you skip your habits. Prune it aggressively!

name: Chaos Thistle
description: Spiky and unpredictable. It appears when your schedule is messy. Order and routine are the only herbicides that work against it.

name: Prism Lotus
description: Refracts light into beautiful rainbows. It represents creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. Feeds on sketches and heavy brainstorming sessions.

name: Spectral Bamboo
description: Ghostly shoots that grow overnight. They symbolize spiritual growth and resilience. They can withstand the strongest emotional storms.
